description: Global search instant-results dropdown (search_dialog-instant-results-list / search_dialog-instant-result-item). Not modeled by any predefined salesforce-pageobjects type - a newer, app-specific search assistant component. Confirmed via live DOM: it renders inside the same assistantPanel dialog overlay as lightning-input.saInput (see globalHeader.utam.json and case.creation.page.js searchGlobal()), not inside .oneHeader. Root is scoped by role+aria-label rather than the results-list id, which changes on every render.
